settings.title: Dressed for the Field
settings.subtitle: Wear the birds. Pacific Northwest field art — wild skies, tall firs, and the two doves that started it all.
settings.bird_panel_body: Every Atlas Dovy piece starts with time outdoors — watching, listening, sketching. Then it comes home to Atlas and Peabody, our two Barbary doves, who inspired every design from the perch up.

settings.title: From Field Notes to Pet Doves
settings.body: Atlas Dovy was born outdoors — sketches from field walks, mornings with binoculars, wild birds of the Pacific Northwest. Then came Atlas and Peabody, two Barbary doves who turned those field notes into something warmer and more personal. Every piece we make lives at that intersection.

settings.title: Rooted in the Places We Love
settings.subtitle: We partner with regional land trusts and wildlife organizations to protect the ecosystems that inspire our designs. 1% of every sale goes directly to conservation.

settings.title: Stay Connected to the Wild
settings.subtitle: New designs, Atlas & Peabody updates, and Pacific Northwest bird stories — straight to your inbox.
